## Summary

Briefly describe the finding.

## Evidence classification

Mark the most appropriate category:

- [ ] `[OFFICIAL]`
- [ ] `[OBSERVED]`
- [ ] `[INFERRED]`
- [ ] `[REPORTED HISTORY]`
- [ ] `[OPEN QUESTION]`

## Hardware

Please include where relevant:

- system model;
- motherboard revision;
- processor;
- flash-chip model;
- network controller;
- other relevant hardware.

## Firmware

Include where relevant:

- firmware version;
- BIOS version;
- image size;
- relevant offsets;
- SHA256 hash or other verification data.

## Method

Describe how the result was obtained.

Include relevant:

- tools and versions;
- commands;
- jumper state;
- power state;
- number of repeated reads or measurements;
- comparison methodology.

## Result

What was directly observed?

## Interpretation

If you are drawing a conclusion from the observation, clearly separate that conclusion from the measured result.

## Reproducibility

Can another researcher reproduce this result?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] Partially
- [ ] Not yet tested

## Sensitive data review

Before submitting:

- [ ] I removed or redacted unnecessary serial numbers.
- [ ] I removed or redacted UUIDs and full MAC addresses.
- [ ] I did not attach a personalized raw SPI/BIOS dump.
- [ ] I removed credentials, tokens, keys, and other secrets.
- [ ] Third-party material is identified and appropriately sourced.

## Sources

Add manufacturer documentation, standards, upstream documentation, or relevant prior research where available.
